name: Fragment Design x Nike Air Zoom Spiridon SP 'Black'
story_html: Launching as part of a collaborative two-piece pack, the Fragment Design x Nike Air Zoom Spiridon 'Black' updates the retro runner with a stealthy monochrome finish. Laces feed through webbing eyelets to secure the black mesh upper, featuring a tonal suede mudguard and lateral-side Swoosh. A cropped white Swoosh adorns the medial side. Wavy lines are etched across the matching black foam midsole, enhanced with responsive Zoom Air cushioning for a comfortable ride.
